As of 2023, it is represented by Democrat Jerry Nadler , redistricted incumbent of the former 10th congressional district, who defeated incumbent Carolyn Maloney in the 2022 Democratic primary. June 09, 2020 | by Gotham Gazette ny12 four Left to right: Rep. Carolyn Maloney, Suraj Patel, Pete Harrison, Lauren Ashcraft The Democratic primary in New York's 12th Congressional District features incumbent Rep. Carolyn Maloney and three challengers: Suraj Patel, Peter Harrison, and Lauren Ashcraft. All four candidates were set to debate Monday night, but Maloney canceled the day of the debate due to illness. Her three challengers met to discuss a variety of issues and strategies in a debate hosted by Empire State Indivisible and moderated by Gotham Gazette's Ben Max. Watch the debate below.
